    Pricing Questions?

    Do you offer payment plans?

    Yes, we offer flexible payment plans for larger projects. You can discuss payment options during your consultation.

    What is included in the pricing?

    Our pricing includes design, development, deployment, and initial support. Additional services like SEO, marketing, and extended support are available.

    Can I upgrade my plan later?

    Absolutely! You can upgrade your plan anytime as your business grows and needs more features.

    Is hosting included?

    Starter and Professional packages include free hosting for the first 3-12 months. After that, hosting is very affordable.

    What about ongoing maintenance?

    We offer separate maintenance packages starting at ₹2,999/month, which includes updates, monitoring, and performance optimization.

    Do you offer discounts for long-term contracts?

    Yes! We provide discounts for annual support contracts and retainer agreements.
